_comment: WHICH BRANCHES MAY NOT REACH master ON AI JUDGEMENT ALONE.
Written 2026-09-13 after six capability-branch merges landed on master in one session
without Tom's word. His ruling: 'Really you should never merge a major branch to master
without my all-clear on completion.' The harm is not a broken build -- every one of those
merges was green -- it is that GREEN IS NOT DONE. A passing suite says the code works; it
says nothing about whether the FEATURE is finished, and only Tom can answer that.
A branch listed here needs a matching entry in dev/branch-all-clears.json, pinned to the
exact commit cleared, before dev/hooks/pre-merge-commit will let it into master.
A branch NOT listed here is an ordinary track -- a defect fix, a doc change, a tooling
change -- and merges on the existing rules: green check_all on the merge result, and the
pre-push stamp. That distinction is the whole design. Do not list everything; a gate that
stops all work is a gate somebody switches off.
THE FREEZE IS A FEATURE FREEZE. IT HAS NEVER BEEN A MERGE FREEZE, AND READING IT AS ONE
BLOCKS BUG FIXES -- which are the entire content of these days.
Tom's plan, stated 2026-09-10 and repeated 2026-09-14 because this repository kept getting
it wrong: freeze FEATURES on 10 September; fix bugs through 14 September; translate on the
14th; then keep fixing bugs AND DEPLOYING THEM through 16 September.
So a bug fix merges to master on the ordinary rules -- green check_all on the merge result
-- and master must stay PULLABLE, because he is pulling it every day. What may not merge is
a FEATURE, and the 'protected' list above is the whole mechanism for that: a capability
branch needs his all-clear.
'active: true' stops EVERY merge but a 'hotfix:'. That is an emergency instrument and it is
OFF. It was ON from 2026-09-13 to 2026-09-14 on a misreading of 'we can't do that if we are
merging our work to master' -- 'our work' meant the capability branches, not the bug fixes
he was waiting on. Tom, 2026-09-14: 'what I am hearing from you blocks bug fixes, and that
is unacceptable.' Do not set it true again without his word.
